lines.en-US: A ridiculous amount of time just
Slips through my fingers again.

lines.japanese: 此処は理想郷では無い

segments.text: 此処は理想郷では無い

lines.en-US: This place is hardly an utopia,

lines.japanese: ましてや描いた未来じゃ無い
lines.zh-CN: 更不是曾经描摹的未来
lines.en-US: Much less future I've envisioned.

lines.japanese: 終わりのない未来など

segments.text: 終わりのない未来など

lines.en-US: An “endless future,” or whatever,
It’s such a trivial and silly idea.
Asking the gaps between my dreams:
"Where do I go?”
Towards the distant, distant beyond,
I kept walking through the pain
The voices of the noisy city
resonated within my head

lines.japanese: 夢の底でもがくのなら
lines.zh-CN: 若只能在梦境深渊挣扎辗转

segments.text: 夢の底でもがくのなら

lines.en-US: If I'm to be left to struggle at the bottom of my dreams,

lines.japanese: この夜をいっそ喰らってしまいたい
lines.zh-CN: 倒不如将这黑夜彻底吞噬殆尽

segments.text: この夜をいっそ喰らってしまいたい

lines.en-US: I'd much rather devour this night for all it's worth.
Just stay by my side till you've had enough of my idiocy.

lines.japanese: 愚かでいい　二度と無い
lines.zh-CN: 哪怕愚蠢也罢 只是想度过
lines.en-US: I don't care if it's stupid. I just want to

lines.japanese: 今を生きていたいだけ
lines.zh-CN: 绝无仅有的当下此刻罢了

segments.text: 今を生きていたいだけ

lines.en-US: Live in the moment that may never repeat
That's all
I’ve just about had enough
Of these stories of hopeless salvation.

lines.japanese: それを優しさと言って絆すなら
lines.zh-CN: 若将那唤作温柔并以此羁绊束缚

segments.text: それを優しさと言って絆すなら

lines.en-US: If you're going to try to call it kindness just to shackle me

lines.zh-CN: 更是愚蠢至极可笑荒唐
lines.en-US: Then that's even more idiotic.
If this were a truthful reality,
then how freeing would that be for me?
Asking the gaps between my dreams:

lines.japanese: 私は何処へと 行くの
lines.en-US: "Where do I go?”

lines.zh-CN: 朝着漆黑深沉的黑暗深处
lines.en-US: Each time I glance toward
The gloomy darkness,
Those asinine remarks
Always overflow my thoughts.

lines.japanese: 夢の途中で目覚めたなら
lines.zh-CN: 若在梦境中途猛然苏醒

segments.text: 夢の途中で目覚めたなら

lines.en-US: If I were to wake up in the midst of this dream,

lines.japanese: この夜は一層濁ってしまうだろう
lines.zh-CN: 这个夜晚想必会变得更加混沌浑浊吧

segments.text: この夜は一層濁ってしまうだろう

lines.en-US: Then this very night would grow all the more murkier.

lines.japanese: 触れた指が解けぬように
lines.zh-CN: 为了不让触碰的指尖松脱分开

segments.text: 触れた指が解けぬように

lines.en-US: So as not to unlink our joined hands

lines.japanese: 今はただ 願うまま
lines.zh-CN: 此刻只想 如愿以偿地
lines.en-US: For now, at least, I simply wish

lines.japanese: 日々を過ごしていたいだけ
lines.zh-CN: 度过每一个日日夜夜罢了

segments.text: 日々を過ごしていたいだけ

lines.en-US: To live out each day as it comes.

lines.japanese: それなのに 曖昧 な温かさで
lines.zh-CN: 明明如此 却因暧昧不清的温存
lines.en-US: And yet, vaguely, I can feel warmth residing within me

lines.japanese: 淡い理想に 魅入られてしまう
lines.zh-CN: 被那虚幻淡薄的理想 迷住了心神
lines.en-US: I find myself entranced by those fleeting idealistic thoughts.

lines.japanese: 心ひとつ吐き 出せないくせに
lines.zh-CN: 明明连真心话都无法坦率吐露
lines.en-US: Try as I might, it seems I cannot unlock my heart.

lines.zh-CN: 真是个任性自私的我啊
lines.en-US: Oh, I must be so selfish.
